Metadata.description: Track jobs, your applications and your profile.

Auth.logInIntro: Track jobs, your applications and your profile.
Auth.signUpIntro: The first account on a new server becomes its admin.
Auth.name: Name

mail.title: Email
mail.intro: Connect your Gmail accounts and the app reads employer replies, then suggests moves on your tracker (a rejection, an interview invitation, an offer). You approve each one.
mail.loadFailed: Could not load your email accounts: {error}
mail.notConfigured: Gmail is not set up on this server yet. Add GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET to your .env file (see the README).
mail.checked: {count, plural, =0 {No new suggestions.} one {1 new suggestion. See it on your tracker.} other {# new suggestions. See them on your tracker.}}
mail.privacy: Read-only: the app can never send, change or delete your mail. It looks at the last two weeks, once an hour, and keeps only the sender, subject and a short snippet of mails that match a job you applied to. Disconnect any time.

result.denied: You did not allow access, so nothing was connected.
result.error: Connecting Gmail did not work. Please try again.
result.not-configured: Gmail is not set up on this server yet.

personal.heading: Personal details
personal.intro: What forms ask about you. Your first and last name also become your account name, used on resumes and letters.
personal.genderHint: Only for forms that ask. Never put on resumes.

about.heading: About you
about.headline: Headline
about.headlineHint: One line, like “Frontend engineer who loves design systems”
about.languagesHint: With your real level, e.g. German A2, English C1. Resumes copy it exactly.
about.keywordsHint: Words from job ads that are true for you. ✓ on the Fit tab adds them here.

answers.heading: Application answers
answers.intro: What every application form asks. The Apply kit gives these to Claude for the cover letter and to Claude in Chrome to fill in forms, exactly as you write them here. Leave out anything you don’t want shared.
answers.addressHint: City and country, or the full address forms ask for
answers.workPermitHint: e.g. EU Blue Card, or no visa needed in the EU
answers.notesHint: Short answers you reuse, like why you are looking for a new job. Claude adapts them to each job.

custom.heading: Your own fields
custom.intro: Anything else forms ask, like Xing, pronouns or a portfolio. The Apply kit passes them on as you write them.
custom.name: Field {n} name

resume.heading: Master resume
resume.intro: Your full resume as plain text. Match scores and tailored resumes start from this.
resume.languageHint: Jobs in this language are checked against it. Add other languages below.
resume.upload: Upload a PDF or Word file
resume.uploadHint: Up to 5 MB. Scanned images can’t be read.
resume.read: Resume read. The text below is what we’ll use; fix anything that came out wrong.
resume.achievementsHint: One true fact per line, with real numbers. Claude may use them in any tailored resume, and the fact check trusts them.
resume.achievementsExample:
Cut page load time by 40% at Acme (2023)
Led a team of 4 developers on the checkout redesign
resume.maxPagesHint: Claude keeps each tailored resume to this length. The PDF check uses it too.
resume.keepSectionsHint: Every section of my resume stays, with my own names and order (Key Highlights, Achievements, Technical Skills…), and every job keeps its projects. Claude only tailors what is inside.

errors.years: Years of experience must be between 0 and 60
errors.fieldsMax: Add at most 30 fields of your own

other.heading: Resume in other languages
other.intro: Optional. Jobs whose ad is in one of these languages are checked against that resume, and the Claude prompt starts from it. Your master resume above stays the main one.
other.savedNote: ✓ Your {language} resume is saved. Jobs in {language} now use it.
other.savedNoteFile: ✓ Your {language} resume is saved (read from {file}). Jobs in {language} now use it.
other.noResume: No {language} resume yet? Let Claude translate your master resume. The prompt keeps every employer, date and number, and your real language levels.
other.copyPrompt: Copy translation prompt and open Claude ↗
other.copied: Copied. Paste it into Claude, then paste Claude’s answer below.
other.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the prompt below instead.
other.uploadSaves: Uploading a file saves it straight away: no need to click Save.

design.heading: Resume and cover letter design
design.intro: How the PDFs you download for a job look. Every template is one column with real text, so applicant tracking systems read it.
design.rendererOff: The PDF renderer isn’t running, so downloads are plain PDFs for now. Start it with
design.rendererMissing: PDF templates are switched off: set PDF_RENDERER_URL in .env, then start the renderer with
design.wordColours: Your Word file keeps its own colours and fonts; these are for the cover letter.
design.showPhoto: Show my photo on the resume
design.photoHint: JPEG or PNG, up to 2 MB. Common in Germany, optional elsewhere.
design.saved: Design saved. Your next PDF downloads use it.
design.wordNone: Want your own layout? Upload your master resume as a Word (.docx) file above, and “My own Word file” appears here.
design.wordUnusable: {file} can’t be used as a template yet.
design.wordUses: My own Word file uses {file}: everything above your first heading stays as it is, and each section is written in the style of yours (found: {sections}).
design.wordPdf: Step 3 of the Apply kit then offers a Word download you can edit. The PDF is made with LibreOffice, which may swap a font it doesn’t have; for an exact PDF, open the Word file and save it as PDF.
design.myDesignIntro: Use the look of your own resume, rebuilt in LaTeX as one clean column that applicant tracking systems read.
design.myDesignStep1: Copy the prompt. Claude opens in a new tab.
design.myDesignStep2: Attach your resume file (PDF, Word or a screenshot) in Claude and send the prompt.
design.myDesignStep3: Paste Claude’s reply below and save. “My design” becomes your default template.
design.myDesignCopy: Copy design prompt and open Claude ↗
design.myDesignCopyFailed: Could not copy. Select the prompt here instead.
design.myDesignTook: What My design took from your resume
design.myDesignTwoColumns: Your resume has two columns. My design puts everything in one column, because applicant tracking systems read two columns in the wrong order.

matcher.intro: Scores each job against your resume (ATS score) and writes a tailored version.
matcher.changeAi: . To change it, set RM_LLM_MODEL in .env, or pick one in
matcher.testHint: Sends one tiny message to the AI provider.
matcher.sending: Sending… Resume-Matcher’s AI is reading your resume, which can take a minute.

suggestions.title: Suggestions for your resume
suggestions.allGood: Your resume looks good. No quick fixes found.
suggestions.LEVEL: Language level differs from My profile ({detail}). Use your real level everywhere.
suggestions.WORK_PERMIT: Your resume mentions “{detail}”. Add it under Applications > Work permit so tailored resumes keep it.
suggestions.DATES: Long dashes in dates ({detail}). Some ATS misread them: write 08/2022 - 05/2026.
suggestions.CLICHES: Generic words recruiters skip: {detail}. Show it with an example instead.
suggestions.SYMBOLS: Symbols an ATS may not read: {detail}
suggestions.NUMBERS: Only {with} of {bullets} bullets have a number. Add results (time saved, scale, team size) where you have them.
suggestions.LENGTH: About {pages} pages ({words} words), more than your limit of {limit}. Tailored resumes will be cut to {limit}, or raise the limit below.
suggestions.ACHIEVEMENTS: Your resume has {count, plural, one {# achievement} other {# achievements}}. Put them in the Achievements bank so every tailored resume can use them.
suggestions.askClaudeHint: Paste it into Claude: it reviews your resume like a recruiter and lists the top fixes.

notify.heading: Notifications
notify.newMatches: Tell me when a scheduled search finds new jobs that fit me
notify.newMatchesHint: You get a 🔔 notification with the best jobs and a link to each.
notify.fitMinHint: Its Fit % must be at least this.

claudeAnswers.heading: Answers for Claude
claudeAnswers.intro: Your answers to Claude’s questions, kept for the next job. Edit or delete any.
claudeAnswers.fill: Fill in my saved answers by themselves
claudeAnswers.stretches: Show Stretches (lines that may be hard to explain)
claudeAnswers.none: No saved answers yet. Answer one of Claude’s questions on a job and it shows up here.

Jobs.intro: Search, filter and track the jobs you imported. Click a title for details.
Jobs.hiddenIntro: Only you don’t see these. Unhide a job to put it back in your table, or click “All jobs” to go back.

undo.hidMany: Hid {count, plural, one {# job} other {# jobs}}.
undo.backMany: Brought back {count, plural, one {# job} other {# jobs}}.

recalculate.hint: Fit % updates by itself when your resume or the jobs change. Click to work it out again now

errors.queue: Could not add to the Apply queue: {error}

format.estimatedLevelHint: Estimated from the ad’s words: Grundkenntnisse ≈ A2, gut ≈ B2, fließend or verhandlungssicher ≈ C1, Muttersprache ≈ C2

cards.label: Show jobs by status
cards.newHint: Jobs imported since your last visit

toolbar.active: {count, plural, one {# filter active} other {# filters active}}

row.fitHint: How much of the job’s skills, keywords and title your resume covers. Click for details

row.selectAll: Select all jobs on this page
row.expiredHint: The ad is closed (found by the still-open check or the job board)

popup.aiIntro: Scores your master resume (the one on My profile) with Resume-Matcher. It does not use the resume Claude wrote in the Apply tab. Each run uses your Claude API credits. The Fit tab gives the same kind of score for free.
popup.noDescription: This job has no description, so there is nothing to match.

ad.youHave: You have it: on your profile’s Skills list

interview.intro: Get ready for the interview with Claude. It uses only your resume, so nothing is made up for you. Copy the prompt into Claude, then bring the reply back here to keep it with the job.
interview.gapsHint: Skills the ad asks for that your resume doesn’t show. The prompt asks Claude for an honest answer to each.
interview.noGaps: Your resume covers every skill the ad asks for.
interview.noResume: Add your resume on My profile to see which skills the interviewer may ask about.
interview.german: The ad asks for German {level}. Practise your answers in German, at your real level.
interview.germanAny: The ad asks for German. Practise your answers in German, at your real level.
interview.copyHint: Questions, model answers from your resume, your gaps and questions to ask.
interview.copiedHint: Paste it into Claude, then bring the reply back below.
interview.paste: Paste Claude’s reply from the clipboard
interview.pasteHint: Or paste it in the box.
interview.blocked: The browser blocked reading the clipboard. Paste the reply in the box instead.

fit.removeHint: I don’t have it: remove from this job
fit.haveHint: On your profile’s Skills list: counted as covered, and the prompt asks Claude to add it
fit.removedSummary: {count, plural, one {# term} other {# terms}} removed, left out of the score and the prompt
fit.howText: Plain word matching against your resume (free, no AI), weighted like Resume-Matcher’s ATS score:
fit.germanReason: The ad is in German or asks for German, so the prompt asks for a German resume
fit.mismatch: . Add your resume in {language} on “My profile” so its keywords can be found.
fit.addResume: Add your resume on “My profile” to see which of these you are missing.
fit.keywordsHint: Tick ✓ the ones you really have. They go to your profile’s Keywords, so they count for every job. The prompt asks Claude to work each ticked one in.
fit.youHaveHint: From your profile’s Skills and Keywords. Your resume doesn’t name them yet: the prompt asks Claude to work each one in.
fit.iHaveKeywordHint: I have this: add it to my profile’s Keywords

hints.keywords: The job’s keywords found in your resume
hints.skills: The job’s required and preferred skills in your resume
hints.title: The exact job title in your headline (best) or summary
hints.sections: Contact details, summary, experience, education and skills present
hints.dates: All dates written in one format

match.title: Resume match
match.pending: Matching your resume against this job… This usually takes one to two minutes. You can close this popup; the score will appear in the Match column.
match.startHint: Resume-Matcher scores your resume like an ATS would. Uses a few cents of AI credit.
match.outdated: You sent a newer resume since this score. Match again for a current one.

match.injectableTitle: In your resume, but not where an ATS looks

tailor.title: Tailored resume and cover letter
tailor.pending: Tailoring your resume and writing a cover letter… This usually takes one to three minutes. You can close this popup and come back.
tailor.startHint: Rewrites your resume for this job and writes a cover letter, as PDFs. Uses more AI credit than a match.
tailor.outdated: You sent a newer resume since. Tailor again to use it.
tailor.fromScore: Tailored from {file}. ATS score of the tailored version: {score} / 100.
tailor.noCover: The cover letter couldn’t be written this time. Tailor again to retry.

apply.askOpened: You opened this posting. Did you apply?
apply.step1Title: Claude writes your resume, cover letter and form answers
apply.step1Intro: One prompt, one reply. It knows the job, your master resume and your Application answers.
apply.step1Hint: Claude opens in a new tab with the prompt on your clipboard: paste it and send. When Claude answers, copy its whole reply and come back for step 2.
apply.noAnswers: Add your Application answers on “My profile” (phone, work permit, notice period, salary) so Claude and the form get them.
apply.step2Title: Paste Claude’s reply, get your PDF
apply.step2Intro: In Claude, copy the whole reply (the copy button under it). One click here saves it, scores it and downloads the resume PDF.
apply.downloading: ✓ Your resume PDF is downloading. Find it in your Downloads folder and attach it to the application.
apply.noReply: No reply saved yet. Claude in Chrome can still fill in the form from your profile.
apply.step3Title: Let Claude in Chrome fill in the form
apply.step3Intro: It reads your Apply kit, fills in the posting’s form and stops before Submit. You attach the PDF, check it and press Submit.
apply.copyChrome: Copy prompt for Claude in Chrome
apply.readsKit: Claude in Chrome reads the <link>Apply kit page</link>

languages.label: Languages on this resume
languages.hint: Click to edit the languages line for this job
languages.customHint: Edited for this job only. Reset goes back to your profile’s Languages.

reply.pasteHint: One click: saves the reply, downloads the PDF.

reply.placeholder: Or paste Claude’s whole reply here, or drop a PDF, Word, text or Markdown file
reply.aiHint: Scores this resume the way the AI match tab scores your master resume. Uses AI credits and takes a minute or two.

reply.pdfProblems: {count, plural, one {# thing} other {# things}} to fix

sync.locationsHint: Optional, comma separated, e.g. Berlin, Bavaria

sync.jobTypeHint: None ticked = any type. Ads that don’t say are kept.
sync.minSalaryHint: Only about half of ads post a salary, and the rest are skipped. Leave empty to keep them.
